title: Two wizards become friends, see each other online and offline, then one ignores the other
notes: Two clients enter WizardCity/WC_Hub as say-and-emote.json has them, the companion facing the main wizard across the fountain.
The main wizard clicks the companion, whose card opens on the right, chooses the face with a plus and says Yes to the client's
Friend question; the game server stores the request, the companion's client asks whether to accept the main wizard and the
companion says Yes, and both friendships are stored. Each client opens its friends list from the portrait at the top right,
which lists the other under Online Friends, then opens the friend's card from the list and asks to go to that friend: the
client looks the ZoneName MSG_BUDDYENTRY carried up as a locale key and names the zone in its Teleport question, which is
answered No. The companion then quits from its in-world menu and the main client logs its friend's status turning to offline
and says so; the companion is started again and plays back to where it stood. It speaks, which the main wizard is shown; the
main wizard opens the companion's card again, now a friend's, chooses its crossed-out speech bubble and says Yes to the
question that ignoring removes the friend, the ignore is stored, and the companion's next line is shown to nobody while its
own client still shows it. Opening a card sends MSG_BUDDYSTATS, which waits for the character sheet 12.03 builds, and makes
the client cache that wizard's files in its own CharacterRegistry folder, which references.json lists as client writes.
